question: Should `submitText` become the permanent shared Plugin SDK result for interactive handlers, with supporting channels routing it through normal inbound handling and unsupported channels ignoring it?
rationale: This is an additive public plugin API and establishes cross-channel semantics that repository policy reserves for explicit maintainer direction even though the implementation appears technically sound.

options.title: Approve shared result
options.body: Accept the shared typed contract after live Discord proof confirms authorization, exact-once delivery, and source-context routing.

options.title: Keep channel-specific results
options.body: Retain Telegram’s existing result and expose a Discord-specific result instead, avoiding a shared promise until more channels need the behavior.

options.title: Redesign typed action
options.body: Pause this PR and define a broader typed interactive action contract if maintainers expect more result actions than submitted text.

recommendation.title: Approve shared result
recommendation.body: Accept the shared typed contract after live Discord proof confirms authorization, exact-once delivery, and source-context routing.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects this person to the public Plugin SDK and plugin runtime contract surfaces changed here.
